concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑009 (a‑priori power analysis to determine the minimum number of matched pairs) is not addressed by any task. No task performs the required pre‑data‑collection power analysis, leaving the study without documented justification for the target sample size.

Functional Requirement FR‑012 (extraction and storage of individual MaintenanceEvent records) has no corresponding task. The pipeline extracts churn and latency metrics (T007) but never creates the per‑event JSON (`maintenance_events.json`) required by the contract.

Success Criterion SC‑007 (ensuring a minimum proportion of matched pairs have both churn and latency metrics) is not covered by any task. There is no verification step that checks or reports the coverage rate of metric extraction across matched pairs.
